topic: How 'attention amnesia' is secretly ruining your long AI image prompt chains
image_prompts: A prompt engineer in her late 30s, a cluttered home office with sticky notes and dual monitors at dusk, leaning close to read lines of dense text on a screen, blue-hour ambient glow mixing with the cool monitor light casting shadows under her chin, shot on Leica M11, 35mm f/1.4, Kodak Portra 400, natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field with the sticky note wall soft behind her.

A mid-length printed text document spread across a weathered oak desk in a sunlit studio apartment, mid-morning, the first paragraph highlighted in yellow marker fading by the third page, hard directional sun slicing across the paper surface at a low angle emphasizing the texture of the page and ink bleed, shot on Hasselblad X2D, 100mm macro, Fuji Pro 400H, micro-contrast, fine grain, tight overhead close-up framing with visible coffee ring stain at the edge.

A man in his late 20s seated cross-legged on a rooftop in Oaxaca, golden afternoon light behind him, holding a phone and squinting at a long prompt chain scrolling on screen, surrounding rooftops and terracotta tiles visible in the wide background, hard golden hour backlight creating a rim around his silhouette, shot on Sony A7R V, 24mm wide-angle, Kodak Gold 200, analog halation around the bright sky, visible grain, full-body environmental framing showing scale of the open urban rooftop.

A close-up of two hands belonging to a woman in her 40s, a dark research lab environment at night, one finger pressing on a printed neural-attention diagram pinned to a corkboard, single tungsten lamp casting warm directional light from the upper right, deep shadows filling the frame edges, shot on Fujifilm X-T5, 85mm f/1.4 portrait, Cinestill 800T, strong analog halation around the lamp's edge, grain visible in the shadows, tight medium framing with diagram text slightly out of focus.

A wide environmental portrait of a young designer, early morning, sitting alone at a long communal table in an empty Tokyo co-working space, surrounded by scattered printouts of AI-generated images with handwritten margin notes, overcast diffused light from large north-facing windows washing the space evenly, shot on Fujifilm GFX 100, 50mm f/1.8, Fuji Pro 400H, soft natural skin texture, subtle film grain, low-angle framing from table height looking slightly upward to show the full expanse of the room.

topic: Hero Studio Photos vs real photographers: where AI headshots still get caught
image_prompts: A Black woman in her early 50s, professional blazer slightly rumpled at the shoulder seam, standing in the doorway of a Lagos open-air market stall in late afternoon, glancing sideways at something off-frame, her collar catching hard directional sun that throws a sharp shadow across her neck and clavicle, shot on Hasselblad X2D, 85mm f/1.4 portrait, Kodak Portra 400, natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field pulling the background into warm blur.

A wide medium shot of a South Asian man in his mid-40s seated at a bustling Mumbai tea counter at noon, collared linen shirt pulling across his upper back as he leans forward on both elbows with a glass in hand, overhead hard midday sun casting complex ear-to-jaw shadow geometry the AI typically smooths away, shot on Canon EOS R5, 35mm f/1.4, Fuji Pro 400H, micro-contrast on fabric texture, grain visible in the shadows, documentary candid framing.

Overhead low-angle looking up at a woman in her late 30s, cropped natural hair, standing under a corrugated metal awning in Medellín at dusk, collar of her linen shirt bunched and twisted at the back of her neck from movement, blue hour ambient light mixing with a warm tungsten lamp from a nearby stall, shot on Fujifilm X-T5, 24mm wide-angle, Cinestill 800T, analog halation around the tungsten source, visible grain, real fabric crease detail dominant in frame.

Tight environmental portrait of an older Japanese man, late 60s, seated on a low wooden stool outside a Kyoto ceramics workshop mid-morning, his work shirt collar stiff and unevenly buttoned, overcast diffused light rendering every skin fold and ear cartilage ridge with no flattering fill, shot on Leica M11, 50mm f/1.8, Ilford HP5 black and white, strong micro-contrast, visible pores and deep tonal range, background pots and kiln barely resolved.

A low-angle medium shot of a mixed-race woman in her late 20s walking briskly through a rainy São Paulo pedestrian arcade, trench coat collar turned up and visibly damp, catching window light from the left that makes the wet fabric texture and ear-to-jaw shadow line unmistakable, motion blur on her stride, shot on Sony A7R V, 35mm f/1.4, Kodak Gold 200, slight motion blur on coat hem, natural skin texture, subtle film grain.
